description: This file defines the LeaveDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to decorate and manipulate Leave entity instances, including setting employee and leave type references, retrieving formatted leave status, date, duration, start/end times, and fetching the last comment.

classes.name: LeaveDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Leave entity, providing methods to augment the leave data with additional formatting, references, and related information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveDecorator with a specific Leave instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the leave based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type based on leave type id.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the leave status as a user-friendly string, e.g., 'Pending Approval'.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusName
methods.description: Returns the internal leave status name as a string, e.g., 'PENDING APPROVAL'.

methods.name: getLeaveDate
methods.description: Returns the leave date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

methods.name: getLeaveDuration
methods.description: Returns the leave duration description based on the leave's duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time if duration includes specific times, formatted as H:i.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time if duration includes specific times, formatted as H:i.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave.
